title: Terminal Commands Every Developer Uses
intro: You don't need to be a Linux expert. These commands cover most of your daily terminal work.

slides.heading: Navigation
slides.subtitle: Know where you are and move around.
points: ls -la lists files, including hidden ones
cd folder moves into a folder

slides.heading: Files & folders
slides.subtitle: Create, copy, move and delete.
points: touch file creates an empty file
cp copies, mv moves or renames
rm deletes for good: there's no trash

slides.heading: Reading files
slides.subtitle: Look inside without an editor.
points: less file lets you scroll through it
tail -f file follows a log live

slides.heading: Processes
slides.subtitle: See and control what's running.
points: chmod +x script.sh makes a script runnable
sudo runs a command as admin

cta: Which terminal command do you use the most?
